# SE worker-speed provider admission fixture

This disposable F200/Space Exploration `0.7.57` fixture declares one reviewed finite prerequisite closure and has four versioned roles under its single mod identity. It is host-controlled fixture apparatus, not a player source, migration, graph solver, or release artifact.

| Role | Fixture | MIR | Cap | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | `0.1.0` | `5.0.20015` | 0 | Validates the fixed 196-row finite declaration before direct ordered source grants, then records actual per-force rows. |
| `admission` | `0.2.0` | `5.0.20015` | 0 | Reads the source through a real configuration callback, holds two unchanged ticks, and writes one owned admission save. |
| `old` | `0.3.0` | `5.0.20015` | 10 | A passive expected-old opponent that records the retained source before stopping. |
| `candidate` | `0.4.0` | `5.0.20018` | 10 | Requires admitted provenance and all recorded rows before its single ordinary level-ten completion, save, and cold reads. |

`prerequisites.lua` is the explicit fixed closure captured offline from accepted data-stage raw input `AB6B409DAC6FED18DDE74461311BCDB33FAEAD9AA6CB9138E6349A20B3FB67BE`. It is a static ordered declaration with exact direct parents; runtime code neither discovers ancestors nor invokes recursive research, research-all, or a fallback closure.

Only `source` writes the declared prerequisite research state. Admission reads and compares actual public rows, flags, current research, queue, exact zero saved progress, and bonuses without repairing them. The source records player level ten at 27% with two tail entries, an unrelated fixture-native foreign research at 42%, and an idle earned level thirteen frame. The candidate may observe the product-normalized single player tail entry, but it still binds all finite rows, source flags, current work, queues, bonuses, and exact zero saved progress before any fixture metadata or lab is written.

The candidate records a non-scripted level-ten completion observed at level eleven, refuses any level-eleven start or queued continuation, requires positive-but-consumed science, holds two ticks, saves once, and makes cold reads through local load flags only. Its markers are `source`, `admission-pre-hold`, `admission-saved`, `admission-cold`, `old-opponent`, `candidate-pre-work`, `candidate-complete`, and `candidate-cold` beneath `script-output/se-worker-speed-provider/`.

Host controls are implementation checks only. They do not prove that Space Exploration admits the source configuration, that MIR15/MIR18 applies the assumed queue normalization, that a native save transitions safely, or that any historical/candidate/release scenario is qualified. Those require separately frozen package/controller inputs and native source, admission, old-opponent, candidate-completion, save, and cold evidence.
